# CueMirror

> A simple, fast teleprompter for video, live streams and presentations. Look at the camera, not at your notes, and record the take right in the app.

CueMirror is a teleprompter app for iPhone and Android by EmQube. No account. No cloud. No watermark.

## Free

- Script library with an editor and autosave
- Dictate scripts with your keyboard's microphone
- Adjustable speed, text size and margins
- Text and background colors, light and dark theme
- Alignment, line spacing and a reading line
- Countdown before you start
- Quick adjustments while you read

No time limit, no watermark.

## Premium

Monthly or annual subscription.

- Record yourself with the front camera while you read
- Mirrored and Flipped modes for teleprompter glass
- Precise speed in words per minute and a target duration for each script
- Import .txt, .docx and .pdf files, and export scripts as .txt
- Bluetooth keyboard or pedal as a remote control
- Floating window over other apps (Android)
